system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 15 minutes, 4 Spell Uses. Lasts: Until Recast. Creates an eyeball on an inanimate object that the caster sees through at any distance, in addition to their own eyes. It can't be closed. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
